focal_claims_rationale: The article states four hypotheses (H1A, H1B on D01 PDF page 4; H2 on page 7; H3 on page 7) and says that Model 2 of Table 5 tests H1A/H1B and Model 3 tests H2/H3 (D01 page 10, right column), with the formal hypothesis tests carried out through the marginal effects in Table 6 (D01 page 12: 'Hypothesis 1 was tested using the marginal effects at the game level ... estimated from Model 2'; 'Hypotheses 2 and 3 were tested using the marginal effects by quarter estimated from the Model 3 parameters'). C1-C4 are therefore focal, with Table 5 odds ratios as the primary estimates and Table 6 marginal effects as the stated hypothesis tests. The likelihood-ratio and difference tests (C7-C9) are inference diagnostics; the quarters-remaining check and the by-request analyses (C11, C12) are robustness; Tables 1-4 and the text percentages are descriptive; the remaining control-variable statements are nuisance controls.
